# Chapter 8 — Fractals

Source: https://natureofcode.com/fractals/

Key concepts: recursion, self-similarity, Cantor set, Koch curve, trees, L-systems, escape-time fractals (Mandelbrot), recursive branching.

Seeds:
- Fractals chapter uses recursion and self-similarity to generate natural forms.
- Trees, Koch curves and L-systems grow from recursive replacement rules.
- Escape-time fractals like Mandelbrot map complex iteration into visual structure.
